While it is true that technology can have negative consequences, its overall impact on society is overwhelmingly positive, fostering progress, connection, and innovation.

One of the most significant positive impacts of technology is its role in enhancing communication. No matter how far apart individuals are, they can now communicate instantly with people on the other side of the world. This has strengthened global relationships, facilitated international collaboration, and made it easier for people to share ideas, cultures, and experiences. In a world that was once divided by distance, technology has brought people together, creating a more interconnected and understanding global community.

Imagine you have a really smart friend who loves to guess what you're going to do next. You play a game where you show them a picture, and they guess what's in the picture.
